verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own materials say popular desktop apps such as Firefox, Chrome, Discord, Steam and OBS Studio are available, and claim thousands of applications backed by the Ubuntu archive. However, nothing in the evidence describes a built-in graphical app store or a single-click install flow, so only the app-availability part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: any documentation of a built-in app store (e.g. App Center), evidence of one-click installation, and hands-on or community confirmation that switchers can install apps this way.
